decision: Recast from 'ledger reconciliation + closeout cards' to the ActionItem RESOLVABILITY CONTRACT per operator direction. Root cause is structural: DontPanic emits operator actions without proving they are still relevant, sufficient, recomputed after action, or cleared when the condition is gone (live: 54/57 gate cards target completed/abandoned plans; reconcile card couldn't round-trip). Spine = clears_when + resolution_class (F001), round-trip recompute/suppress-at-source + global-scope eval (F002), phantom suppression proof (F003), reconcile/global readiness round-trip + chaining + operator_attested (F004), generic round-trip invariant test over every emitter (F005). Individual bad cards become regression cases, not the unit of work.
